title: Version 3.1.6 Changelog
items: Set the storage bucket in Settings instead of .env
Check a bucket's access before saving its settings
Store the bucket secret key encrypted and never return it
Show a banner until a storage bucket is connected
Return 503 for file content while no bucket is set
Set Google sign-in in Settings instead of .env
Check the Google client ID and secret before saving
Set the session timeout and access tracking in Settings
End idle sessions as soon as the timeout is shortened
Stop logging out active users 30 days after login
Let only the first user set Cloud Drive save-only
Keep Cloud Drive save-only until the server answers
Require a random 32-byte master key in production
Refuse to start when a master key does not match stored data
Read secrets from files named by <NAME>_FILE
Keep master key versions in one keyring
Add npm run rotate for the master key and DB password
Rewrap file keys on an older key version when the worker starts
Add setup.sh for one-command Docker installs
Add update.sh to update Docker installs with a database backup
Add rotate.sh to rotate keys and passwords on Docker installs
Install the database backup script with setup and update
Stop the backup script from touching other projects' databases
Stop app and worker and clear the cache during a restore
Fix checksum mismatches for backup paths with a backslash
Stop the worker reporting unhealthy in Docker
Remove one-time encryption migration scripts
Pick the log format from the terminal and remove LOG_FORMAT
Remove the force-save and queue metrics interval settings
Keep files selected when the marquee scrolls past them
Use larger themed cursors and keep the arrow over file rows
Check the install scripts with shellcheck in CI
Update CI action versions
